**Slides.** [Open the deck at this part](../../slides/eu-frames-one-day-open-science.html#/part-2-the-claim-and-its-estimand){target="_blank"} in its own tab, or follow it on the [slides page](slides.qmd).

Part 2 reads the paper in full, then argues that analysts who look as though they disagree are often answering different questions, and gives you the estimand statement as the way of saying which question you are answering. It ends with the five Task 2 analyses read as five questions, which is where the choice of Part 3 comes from.

| Work through | What you do | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| Slides, the paper in full | The four framing scales, the model that the original author (OA) fitted, Model 1 and Model 2, which put the robustness question inside the paper, the data of OA against the course panel, the attempts to reproduce the paper and the replication on new data, and the five questions that the Multi100 analysts asked in the free phase. | 22 minutes |
| Slides, estimands | The red-card estimates again as a single row, four estimands drawn out of one football question, the spread that collapses once the estimand is fixed, and research questions that leave the estimand open. | 18 minutes |
| Slides, theoretical and empirical estimands | Lundberg's three steps from a theoretical quantity to an empirical one. | 7 minutes |
| Slides, the estimand statement | The template for the claim of the day: everyone writes a one-sentence statement, holds it and sends it together. Then the five Task 2 analyses side by side, each with its unit, outcome, series and comparison, as five answers to five questions. | 15 minutes |
| [Browser lab](../../cases/eu-frames/lab.qmd) Task 2 | Look at the panel and find the countries that move sharply around 2009, then write your estimand statement properly with the template on the page. The causal graph below the template is optional today. | 25 minutes |

**By the end of the part** you have an estimand statement for the claim in your notes, and you can say which question each of the five analysts answered.
